title: HALF-LIGHT DENIM
body_html:
The Half-Light Denim exists somewhere between two worlds — one washed in pale sun, the other aged by time. A deliberate split construction transforms an everyday staple into something far less predictable, creating a silhouette that feels familiar from a distance and entirely different up close.

Cut with a relaxed wide-leg profile, the piece falls effortlessly through the leg, allowing the contrasting washes to speak for themselves. The drawstring waist introduces an unexpected utility detail, softening the structure while adding comfort to the equation.

This is not denim for those looking to blend into the background. It is denim for the collector who understands that the strongest pieces often live in contradiction.

title: The ACNE Gym Bro Tee
body_html:
A heavyweight statement piece that merges vintage athletic aesthetics with contemporary luxury. Rendered in a deep washed-brown tone, this oversized tee features raised leather-style appliqué lettering across the chest, paired with a distressed weightlifting graphic and tonal script detailing. The result is a rich mix of texture, depth, and character that feels both nostalgic and elevated.

Designed with a relaxed silhouette and structured drape, it’s the kind of piece that stands confidently on its own or layered over shirting for a more directional look.

title: Technical Alpine Carabiner Boot – Ash Grey
body_html:
A rugged outdoor silhouette reimagined through a contemporary lens. Crafted with a premium suede upper and reinforced panel construction, this technical boot balances utilitarian function with elevated design.

Featuring extended hiking laces, metal hardware detailing, and a heavy-duty lug sole, it delivers a distinctive statement while maintaining everyday versatility. The soft ash-grey finish offers a refined alternative to traditional black footwear, pairing effortlessly with cargos, denim, technical outerwear, and relaxed tailoring.

Details
• Premium suede and reinforced panel construction
• Extended lace system with metal eyelets
• Padded high-top collar for enhanced comfort
• Durable lug outsole with aggressive traction
• Technical outdoor-inspired design
• Ash Grey colourway

Designed for those who appreciate functional aesthetics, modern utility and understated statement pieces.

title: STUART WEITZMAN AUGUSTINE BOOT
body_html:
A modern western silhouette refined through a luxury lens.

The Augustine Boot by Stuart Weitzman combines polished leather construction with a sharp square toe and sculpted block heel, creating a striking balance between classic craftsmanship and contemporary edge. Its sleek mid-calf profile and glossy finish make it an effortless statement piece, whether paired with relaxed denim, tailored trousers, or elevated streetwear.

Details

* Premium polished leather upper
* Square toe design
* Sculpted block heel
* Side zip closure
* Mid-calf silhouette
* Leather lining and sole

Color: Black

A timeless investment boot that moves seamlessly between casual and elevated styling.

title: BAD BLOOD STUDIOS LOUNGE PANTS
body_html:
The Bad Blood Studios Lounge Pants are cut in a wide, easy silhouette and finished in a crisp off-white fabric with fine black pinstripes. Designed with an elasticated waistband and subtle branding details, the piece balances comfort and structure, making it equally suited for laid-back days and elevated styling.

The flowing fit creates a strong shape without feeling restrictive, while the striped pattern adds depth and visual texture. Pair with oversized tees, knitwear, or lightweight shirting for an effortless look.

title: Bape WGM Patent Black/Red
body_html:
The BAPE STA has long stood as one of the most recognizable silhouettes to emerge from Japanese street culture, borrowing the familiar language of basketball sneakers and transforming it into something unmistakably its own. This edition doubles down on that legacy with a glossy black patent upper, bold red STA branding, shark detailing, and the iconic WGM lettering across the heel.

The contrast between the black patent finish and the sharp red accents gives the pair a graphic, almost collectible quality—equally at home with oversized denim, cargos, or a simple monochrome fit.

For those who understand streetwear history, this isn’t just footwear. It’s a reminder of an era when niche labels became global cultural symbols through identity, community, and originality.

title: HOLLYWOOD CRAVING DISTRESS TEE
body_html:
A graphic piece that feels pulled from the margins of a forgotten publication. Faded typography, fragmented visuals, and subtle distressing come together to create a tee that sits somewhere between underground culture, archival design, and worn-in nostalgia.

The oversized silhouette and raw details give it the character of a garment that’s already lived a story, while the washed cream base makes it easy to pair with vintage denim, cargos, or layered outerwear.

Not a loud statement piece. The kind of graphic tee that reveals more the longer you look at it.

Model wears M.

title: Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 Metallic Silver
body_html:
The Mexico 66 takes one of Onitsuka Tiger’s most recognizable designs and pushes it into statement territory with a reflective silver leather upper, contrasted by vintage-inspired cream stripes, laces, and sole detailing.

Lightweight, low-profile, and endlessly versatile, this pair sits somewhere between retro sportswear and modern fashion. The metallic finish catches attention without feeling loud, making it the kind of sneaker that elevates even the simplest outfit.

Whether paired with relaxed denim, tailored trousers, or oversized silhouettes, the Mexico 66 Metallic Silver brings a distinctive edge while remaining easy to wear.

Why We Selected It
Not every sneaker needs to be chunky or overdesigned to make an impression. This pair delivers personality through material and finish alone; a subtle standout for those who appreciate pieces that feel different without trying too hard.

title: SCULPTED FLARE TROUSERS
body_html:
A sharp reinterpretation of classic tailoring through an experimental silhouette.

The Sculpted Flare Trousers feature a structured straight fit through the thigh before expanding into a dramatic flare below the knee. Architectural panel construction and subtle utility-inspired detailing create a shape that feels both futuristic and timeless.

Designed for those who appreciate garments with presence, these trousers challenge conventional proportions while remaining surprisingly wearable when paired with oversized knits, fitted tops, or layered outerwear.

title: SUPREME RUGBY CLUB JERSEY
body_html:
A streetwear staple reimagined through the lens of classic rugby heritage.

 

This Rugby Club Jersey blends athletic influence with everyday wearability, featuring a structured collar, oversized fit, and bold graphic detailing across a heavyweight construction. Designed to stand apart from conventional tees, it brings a sense of character and history to even the simplest outfits.

Whether layered with washed denim, cargos, or relaxed tailoring, it’s the kind of piece that carries presence without demanding attention.

Built for those who appreciate the intersection of sport, culture, and streetwear.

title: STUDDED DENIM FIELD CAP
body_html: The Studded Denim Field Cap takes a classic military-inspired silhouette and reworks it through a distressed black denim finish, finished with scattered metal stud detailing throughout. The result is a piece that feels collected rather than manufactured

title: ARCHIVE EAGLE ZIP HOODIE
body_html:
A heavyweight zip hoodie finished with a vintage-inspired wash and bold all-over graphics that feel pulled from a forgotten archive.

Featuring distressed eagle artwork, faded racing influences, and worn-in detailing throughout, the Archive Eagle Zip Hoodie delivers the character of a well-traveled piece without sacrificing comfort. The relaxed silhouette and full-zip construction make it an easy layer for everyday wear, while the aged finish gives each outfit a sense of depth and individuality.

Built for those who appreciate pieces with presence, texture, and a story behind them.

Details

• Heavyweight cotton blend
• Full zip closure
• Vintage washed finish
• Distressed eagle graphics throughout
• Relaxed oversized fit
• Ribbed cuffs and hem
• Unisex

Style Notes

Pair with faded denim, cargos, or wide-leg trousers for a naturally effortless look. Strong enough to stand alone, easy enough to layer year-round.

Tug Of Looks Edit

Selected for its archival-inspired graphics, washed character, and standout silhouette. A statement hoodie that brings vintage energy into a modern wardrobe.

title: Need A Pillow Thermal Top
body_html:
A piece that feels pulled from someone’s archive.

Constructed from textured waffle-knit cotton with contrasting camouflage raglan sleeves, the Need A Pillow Thermal Top blends military influence with underground streetwear energy. The cropped silhouette and worn-in aesthetic give it the feel of a vintage find, while the graphic statement across the chest adds just enough attitude without overwhelming the piece.

Easy to layer, easy to style, and designed for those who appreciate clothing that says more through feeling than logos.

Details

  • Waffle-knit thermal construction
  • Contrasting camouflage raglan sleeves
  • Relaxed cropped fit
  • Ribbed neckline
  • Front graphic print
  • Lightweight layering piece

title: WC CHOPPERS DISTRESSED CUT-OFF TEE
body_html:
This distressed sleeveless tee carries the unmistakable West Coast Choppers identity, featuring a faded front emblem and the iconic flaming cross graphic across the back. Heavy distressing throughout the garment gives it a naturally worn character, while the washed black finish adds years of attitude and authenticity.

Designed with a relaxed cut and raw sleeveless silhouette, it’s the kind of piece that feels equally at home layered under outerwear or worn solo as the statement.

For those drawn to vintage motorcycle culture, underground graphics, and garments with real presence.

title: CARBON DRIFT UTILITY SHORTS
body_html:
The Carbon Drift Utility Shorts combine heavyweight workwear construction with a faded flame pattern woven into the fabric, creating a look that feels worn-in, intentional, and unmistakably different.

Built with utility-inspired pocketing, hammer loop detailing, and a relaxed fit, they’re designed for days that start with no plan and end with stories.

The washed brown finish gives the shorts a naturally aged character, while the tonal flame motif adds depth without overpowering the piece.

title: MR. HENRY STILL RUGBY POLO
body_html:
The MR. HENRY STILL Stripe Rugby Polo combines classic collegiate influences with contemporary streetwear proportions. Constructed with bold black-and-white horizontal stripes, a clean contrast collar, and a relaxed silhouette, it delivers an effortless balance between vintage sport and modern everyday wear.

The front features a subtle embroidered chest graphic, while the back showcases an oversized signature artwork panel that gives the piece its distinct identity. Designed for those who appreciate details that reveal themselves over time.

title: PINDEX TRACK JACKET
body_html:
The PINDEX Track Jacket blends oversized proportions with sharp contrast piping and bold sleeve branding. 

Cut with a relaxed silhouette and lightweight shell construction, it delivers that effortless “off-duty” look while still feeling structured and intentional. The high-neck zip closure and elastic hem give it a clean shape whether worn open or fully zipped.

Pairs naturally with cargos, baggy denim, track pants, or monochrome layers.

title: Pinstripe Hardware Wide Pants
body_html:
Tailoring stripped back and rebuilt for movement.
These wide-leg trousers cut a low, pleated silhouette with a dropped waist and fluid drape, anchored by subtle pinstripe detail on a deep black base. The statement sits at the waist — double S-hook hardware and studded accents replace the standard belt loop setup, giving it an industrial, archival feel.

Designed for presence. Works just as well with a fitted tee and sneakers as it does layered over boots with a cropped jacket.

Details:


Color: Black with tonal pinstripe
Fit: Wide-leg, pleated, relaxed through the thigh
Closure: Hook-and-stud waistband with belt loops
Material: Mid-weight woven — holds structure without stiffness

Why it’s here:
Picked for silhouette and hardware. Foundation piece for fits that lean architectural, street, or quiet-lux. Not basic. Not loud. Just considered.

title: Marlboro F1 Racing Jacket
body_html:
Vintage Motorsports. Modern Streetwear.

Bring 90s F1 energy to your rotation with this red, white, and black racing-inspired jacket. Built for bold looks and everyday wear, it hits the sweet spot between retro motorsports heritage and clean streetwear.

Design & Details


Colorway: Classic red and white color block with black racing stripes down the sleeves
Branding: Embroidered and printed motorsports patches on chest, sleeves, and back including “Marlboro”, “Racing”, “Michelin”, and “Arai” for authentic racewear aesthetic


Fit: Relaxed, structured fit with a stand-up collar and full-zip front. Sits at the waist for easy layering over tees, hoodies, or cargos


Finish: Faux leather material with smooth texture and subtle sheen for that vintage racing jacket look

Material & Care


Outer: Faux leather / PU leather
Lining: Smooth polyester lining for comfort
Closure: Full-length metal zipper + snap collar button
Care: Wipe clean with a damp cloth. Do not machine wash

Sizing: True to size. Model is wearing size L. 

---
Note: This is a fashion-inspired racing jacket. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or produced by Marlboro, Michelin, or Arai. All logos are used for vintage motorsports design reference only.

title: ‘Bound For Glory’ Distressed Tee
body_html:
‘Bound for Glory’ Distressed Tee

Vintage energy, modern fit. This tee takes the ‘Bound for Glory’ film graphic and gives it a washed, lived-in treatment that hits different on-body.

Why it hits:
Story on the chest: Graphic references the 1976 Hal Ashby film, with a faded dual-frame print of motorcyclists and distressed type. It reads like a real vintage find, not a fast-fashion print.


Worn-in feel out the box: Garment-washed fabric with intentional distressing at the neckline, sleeves, and hem. Soft from day one, no stiff break-in period.


Easy oversized fit: Boxy crop with dropped shoulders. Pairs clean with baggy denim, cargos, or layered under outerwear. The cut does the work.

Details:
Material: Heavyweight cotton, garment-dyed and washed
Colorway: Faded Navy / Multi graphic
Fit: Oversized, boxy crop
Graphics: Screen print with vintage wash effect
Distressing: Pre-worn detailing at neck, sleeves, hem

This is for the fits where the tee is the focal point. Throw it on with raw denim and let the wash and graphic do the rest.

title: AFGK ‘Yellow Statement’ Jacket
body_html:
This is the piece that makes the fit. A bold yellow faux leather varsity jacket with heavyweight presence and clean AFGK branding front and back.

Why it stands out:
Color that hits: High-visibility yellow that reads luxury streetwear, not costume. It’s the piece you throw on when the rest of the outfit needs to be simple.


Details done right: Oversized “A” logo on the chest, signature script embroidery, and a large back graphic with the prancing horse emblem and “A.F.G.K” in gothic lettering. Stitching is clean, buttons sit flush, no sloppy edges.


Structure + comfort: Boxy, relaxed fit with ribbed cuffs and hem. Holds shape without feeling stiff. Works layered over tees, hoodies, or even a light knit.

Details:
Material: Faux leather exterior, lined interior
Colorway: Bright Yellow / Black graphics
Fit: Oversized, drop shoulder
Features: Snap button closure, slit pockets, ribbed hem and cuffs

title: Distressed Denim Patch Beanie
body_html:
Small detail, big attitude. This distressed denim beanie is built for when you want to add edge without overthinking it.

The crown is a heavyweight ribbed knit in washed indigo, giving you that slouchy, lived-in feel from day one. The fold-over cuff is where it gets interesting: raw, frayed denim with a bold patchwork logo hit. The contrast between the clean knit and the destroyed denim is intentional — it’s messy, rebellious, and exactly what Tug Of Looks is about.

title: Gnostic Neo-Gothic Crewneck
body_html:
This washed black crewneck is built heavy and printed harder. Front hits with a distressed gargoyle graphic and “Gnostic Visionary Cell” text. Back continues the theme with “Neo-Gothic Bauharoque” and “123” in cracked white print. Sleeves are stamped with bold “RRR” graphics for that uniform feel.

The garment wash gives it a vintage, worn-in look from day one. No stiff collar, no flimsy fabric. It drapes heavy, sits boxy, and pairs clean with your cargos, leather, and boots.

This isn’t a basic crewneck. It’s for guys building a wardrobe with intent.

title: WAFFLE BECKENBAUER TRACK TOP - WONDER WHITE
body_html: It's hard to know which to love more: The high-contrast stand-up collar and cuffs, or how cosy this adidas track jacket is. Feel free to love both equally when you wear it while running errands, on a walk or even out to dinner. Made with cotton waffle, it serves up softness and comfort all around. A slim fit keeps it close, and front zip pockets let you take along whatever you need

title: Gothic Cross & Dagger Wallet Chain
body_html:
Add weight to your fit. This Gothic Cross & Dagger wallet chain is built for guys who want their accessories to have presence.

Heavy-duty stainless steel links give it a solid feel and durability that won’t tarnish or snap after a month. The centerpiece is a detailed fleur-de-lis cross pendant, paired with a dagger charm engraved with gothic lettering. Clip it to your belt loop and wallet to keep your essentials secure while adding that biker/streetwear edge to any outfit.

It’s the detail people notice when you walk past. Works with cargos, denim, leather jackets, and everything in between. If your fit is clean but missing that edge, this is it.

Details:
Material: 316L Stainless Steel, anti-tarnish finish
Length: ∼45cm total chain length
Features: Dual lobster clasps, 3D cross pendant, dagger charm, reinforced links
Color: Antique Silver
Care: Wipe with cloth. Avoid harsh chemicals

title: Silver Foam Runner Slides
body_html:
Minimal design. Maximum comfort. These metallic foam slides are built for all-day wear without compromising the fit.

The one-piece molded foam construction molds to your foot over time, giving you that broken-in feel from day one. Perforated side vents keep things breathable in Lagos heat, while the sculpted sole provides grip and cushion with every step. The metallic silver finish keeps it futuristic and easy to pair with cargos, shorts, or loungewear.

title: Light Wax Utility Pants
body_html:
Built for movement, made to stand out. These black light wax utility cargos blend techwear function with streetwear edge.

The wide-leg silhouette creates a clean drape that stacks over boots or sneakers, while the high-shine finish catches light without looking tacky. Four oversized cargo pockets + zip details give you utility without breaking the line of the fit. Elastic waist with drawcord means you get comfort and adjustability in one.

title: PLAID TRACK JACKET
body_html:
The ROSE Plaid Track Jacket blends vintage sportswear energy with a more refined streetwear feel — featuring a deep green/navy plaid pattern, contrast piping details and a relaxed structured fit designed for effortless layering.

Finished with a full zip closure and subtle embroidered chest branding, this piece works best styled naturally: over washed denim, loose trousers or everyday basics.

title: FORAMDER “12” Rugby Polo
body_html:
A heavyweight rugby-inspired polo built with a rebellious streetwear edge. The FORANDER “12” Rugby Polo features bold mustard and charcoal horizontal striping, distressed varsity-style graphics, and embroidered crest detailing that gives it a worn-in vintage energy without feeling dated.

The oversized “12” print across the front and back brings that classic team uniform aesthetic, while the structured white collar keeps the piece sharp and balanced. Designed with a relaxed fit that sits perfectly over cargos, denim, or wide-leg trousers.

title: FAR ARCHIVE DISTRESSED HAT
body_html: A washed red distressed cap featuring layered “Far From What” typography embroidery across the crown. Finished with raw-edge distressing on the brim and panels for a naturally worn-in feel.
